note: ONE hand-measured TikTok overlay, per tech-spec §12.1 ('Phase 0 ships one hand-measured TikTok overlay as a fixture'). Rectangles are NORMALISED fractions of the canvas, not pixels, so the same fixture applies to a 720x1280 draft and a 1080x1920 final without a second measurement — a pixel-valued overlay would silently be wrong for one of the two tiers. Values are conservative: where the in-app chrome varies by device or by feature availability, the LARGER obstruction is recorded, because an over-large safe zone costs a caption a few pixels of width while an under-large one puts words behind the UI. This is a fixture, not a registry: the real per-surface overlay set is REQ-051 (product Phase 1), and `status` records that honestly.

captionSafeArea.description: The rectangle a caption may occupy without intersecting any obstruction above. Derived from the obstruction list rather than measured separately, so the two can never disagree.
